author: Reggie Ponder
title: Wake County celebrates Good Hope Baptist Church, Wendell American Legion Post 148 - NewsBreak
text:
By Reggie Ponder ,
7 hours ago
Wake County officials and Capital Area Preservation celebrated Preservation Month at Good Hope Baptist Church on Sunday afternoon -- recognizing the historic church in the Shotwell community near Knightdale along with Wendell’s American Legion Post 148.
Good Hope Baptist Church has received historic landmark designation. - Wake County A Color Guard from the Lt. Cedric Harris American Legion Post 148 of Wendell presents the Colors. - Reggie Ponder | The Wake Weekly
Wake County Board of Commissioners Chair Don Mial, who grew up in the Shotwell community as part of the church, said he is proud to represent that part of the county on the board of commissioners.
“This is my family’s home church, so this feels like a joyous homecoming,” Mial said during the ceremony in the church’s sanctuary.
He recognized his mother and other family members who were in attendance.
“We were sharecroppers,” Mial said. “We learned early about hard work and taking care of one another.”
Wake Board of Commissioners Chair Don Mial speaks at the Historic Preservation celebration Sunday afternoon. - Maria T. Ponder | The Wake Weekly
All adults in the church provided the children guidance, support and sometimes “a stern talking-to,” he said.
You couldn’t cut up or be rude anywhere, he said, because everybody seemed to know your mother and father.
Dedicated teachers looked after the children, he recalled.
“At times it looked as if the adults were conspiring to keep us kids in line,” Mial said.
In reality, he said, they were dedicated to making sure the children were okay.
Mial said he is glad to serve as chair of the county commissioners, and added “I owe that to this church, this foundation and this community.”
Members of Good Hope Baptist Church celebrate with elected officials and local preservationists. - Reggie Ponder | The Wake Weekly
He said, “Church isn’t just a place we go -- it is who we are.”
The community cherishes its legacy as it welcomes in new people, Mial said.
Jeremy Badham of Capital Area Preservation Inc. described the Lt. Cedric Harris Post 148 American Legion building in Wendell as an excellent example of a Rustic Revival building, constructed by members of the community as a meeting place for veterans and a center for community activities.
Members of the Lt. Cedric Harris American Legion Post 148 of Wendell celebrate with elected officials and local preservationists. - Reggie Ponder | The Wake Weekly
Good Hope Baptist Church, he said, is an excellent example of Gothic Revival architecture.
Patricia Ann McCullers was recognized for her work in researching the church’s history and leading the effort to gain the historic landmark designation for the structure.
Plaques were presented to Good Hope Baptist Church and the Lt. Cedric Harris Post 148 American Legion in recognition of their designation as historic landmarks.
A highway marker was unveiled in front of Good Hope Baptist Church on South Smithfield Road, Knightdale.
Deacons and other leaders of Good Hope Baptist Church join U.S. Rep. Deborah Ross in front of the highway marker for the Shotwell African American Community. - Reggie Ponder | The Wake Weekly
